title: Urban demo logistics and snap expense journal
content:
Purpose: quick, last-minute reference for the urban demo (booth on 2026-03-14 – 03-15). This is my working journal for reimbursements, vendor coordination, and on-the-ground contingencies. NOT final. Keep receipts; scan immediately; photo backup to Slack #events-receipts.

Immediate expense rules (for me + 2 contractors):
- Per diem guideline: $75/day/person (meals + incidentals). If team spends more, tag to account TRV-EXPO-2026 and add notes.
- Mileage: use company rate 0.655/mile (roundtrip odometer record + Google Maps snapshot).
- Taxis/rideshares: prefer shared receipts; put names in memo. Airport -> hotel: company-paid if flight lands before 20:00.
- Courier / shipping: pre-approved up to $250; anything above needs manager sign-off (Diego).

Receipt capture workflow:
1) Immediately snap photo in phone.
2) Upload to Slack thread #events-receipts with caption: date, amount, category, payer.
3) For cash petty purchases, write brief note and hand paper receipt to People Ops on return.
4) Expense report code: TRV-EXPO-2026 (use exact string).

Packing & arrival timeline (booth 8x10, standard table):
- 03-13 (EOD): box to local courier (see vendor below) OR bring on flights (we have 2 checked bags).
- 03-14 07:30: meet at hotel lobby; load van; arrive venue by 09:15; target setup complete by 11:30.
- Bring: 2 power strips, 1 ethernet dongle, AV adapter kit (HDMI/USB-C), clear packing tape, gaffer tape, Sharpie, extension cord.

Vendor contacts (shortlist + notes):
- Local courier: UrbanFreight Logistics — Priya Shah | mobile: +1 415-555-0189 | pickup window 08:00-12:00 day prior. Note: they will hold at loading dock 3. Fee estimate $120 ground pickup.
- Furniture rental (folding chairs, podium): BayEvent Rentals — Marco Ruiz | mobile: +1 415-555-0224 | contact on arrival for same-day add-ons. Card OK.
- AV on-site tech: Summit AV — Anna Kim | on-site desk ext 204 | mobile: +1 415-555-0312 | confirm mic + laptop HDMI test during setup.
- Food vendor (for demo hospitality): Little Bao Catering — order window 48h; contact: Jason Lin +1 415-555-0437. Keep receipt and menu PDF.

Onsite roles (who does what):
- Asha (me): overall logistics, expense submissions, AV triage.
- Diego: booth lead; handles demos and lead capture; responsible for petty cash box.
- Lina: account setup + lead sync; manages demo laptop and tooling.

Contingencies & quick fixes:
- If AV no-show: use our HDMI -> USB-C dongle and test on demo laptop; adapt presentation to offline mode (local model sandbox) if network flaky.
- Missing shipping box: call UrbanFreight first, then venue receiving (Loading Dock 3) and ask for hold tags under "Redwood Inference / Asha Patel". Keep tracking number in Slack.
- Flight delay over 3 hours: rebook to earliest next flight; ground transport up to $80 covered. Save boarding pass and rebooking emails.

Expense line examples (copy into expense form):
- "Taxi SFO -> Hotel (Asha)" — $42.20 — TRV-EXPO-2026 — tag: transport
- "Courier: booth crates" — $120.00 — TRV-EXPO-2026 — tag: shipping
- "Catering: demo hospitality" — $95.40 — TRV-EXPO-2026 — tag: meals
- "Mileage: home -> venue (roundtrip 72 miles)" — $47.16 — TRV-EXPO-2026 — tag: mileage (attach map link)

Unresolved questions (to follow up before 03-12):
- Confirm whether venue provides table cloths (venue contact said possible but not guaranteed). Action: Diego to confirm by 03-10.
- Does Finance need credit card pre-authorization for the AV tech? Action: ping @finance (see linked artifact EXP-432).
- Are contractor travel meals reimbursed at per diem or actuals? Action: Lina to confirm with HR by 03-11.

Notes to self (short reminders):
- Keep one envelope with emergency cash ($150) labeled "event float".
- Charge demo laptop to 100% and leave power profile on high performance. Bring spare USB-C charger.
- Export leads CSV nightly and drop in Drive folder: /drive/folders/1a2b-demo-assets (linked).

Quick reference (addresses):
- Venue: Hemlock Center — 120 Hemlock Ave, San Francisco, CA 94107 — Loading Dock 3 (enter on Market St side).
- Hotel: Riverbank Suites — 210 Embarcadero Rd, SF (walkable 12 min to venue).

Final thought: This is messy by design — meant for quick scanning while en route. I will tidy into a formal ops handoff doc after the event with final receipts and a concise expense summary.

Last edit notes: 2026-03-10 14:22 — updated UrbanFreight pickup number and added courier contingency steps.
